answer: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') / COUNT(*) AS approval_rate FROM cases WHERE visacls = 'H-1B'

SELECT CASE WHEN ca.docketkey IS NOT NULL THEN 'Attorney Represented' ELSE 'Self-Represented' END AS representation_type, COUNT(*) AS total_applications, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(c.statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') AS certified_applications, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(c.statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') / COUNT(*), 2) AS approval_rate FROM cases c LEFT JOIN case_attorney ca ON ca.docketkey = c.filekey GROUP BY 1

SELECT a.attorney_profile->'highest_court'->>'state' AS jurisdiction_state, COUNT(*) AS total_cases, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(c.statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') AS certified_cases, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(c.statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate FROM case_attorney ca JOIN attorney a ON a.lawmail = ca.counselmail JOIN cases c ON c.filekey = ca.docketkey GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY success_rate DESC, total_cases DESC LIMIT 3

WITH d AS (SELECT to_date(recvday, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS r, to_date(beginday, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS b FROM cases), m AS (SELECT r, b, (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r)) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM b) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r) AS months FROM d), cat AS (SELECT CASE WHEN b < r THEN 'After Start Date' WHEN months = 0 THEN 'Same Month' WHEN months BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '1-3 Months Before' WHEN months BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Optimal Window (4-6 Months)' ELSE 'Early Filing' END AS filing_window FROM m) SELECT filing_window, COUNT(*) AS application_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage FROM cat GROUP BY filing_window ORDER BY application_count DESC

WITH x AS (SELECT c.headct, REPLACE(REPLACE(p.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric AS offered, REPLACE(REPLACE(p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '')::numeric AS prevailing FROM cases c JOIN case_worksite w ON w.dockkey = c.filekey JOIN prevailing_wage p ON p.trackno = w.wagetrack WHERE c.soccd = '15-1253.00' AND p.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' = 'Year'), t AS (SELECT headct, CASE WHEN (offered - prevailing) / prevailing * 100 < 0 THEN 'Below-Market' WHEN (offered - prevailing) / prevailing * 100 <= 10 THEN 'Market-Competitive' ELSE 'Premium' END AS tier FROM x) SELECT tier, SUM(headct) AS total_positions FROM t GROUP BY tier ORDER BY total_positions DESC

WITH s AS (SELECT wsstate AS state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM case_worksite GROUP BY wsstate), h AS (SELECT state, n FROM s WHERE n > 1.5 * (SELECT AVG(n) FROM s)) SELECT STRING_AGG(state, ', ' ORDER BY n DESC) AS hotspot_states, COUNT(*) AS hotspot_state_count FROM h

WITH av AS (
  SELECT ca.counselmail AS attorney, c.visacls, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM case_attorney ca JOIN cases c ON c.filekey = ca.docketkey
  GROUP BY ca.counselmail, c.visacls
), a AS (
  SELECT attorney, SUM(n) AS total_cases, COUNT(*) AS visa_types, MAX(n) AS dom_n
  FROM av GROUP BY attorney HAVING SUM(n) >= 5
), t AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visacls) AS total_types FROM cases),
s AS (
  SELECT a.attorney,
         1 - a.visa_types::numeric / t.total_types AS asi,
         100.0 * a.dom_n / a.total_cases AS dom_pct,
         a.visa_types
  FROM a CROSS JOIN t
)
SELECT CASE WHEN dom_pct > 80 THEN 'Specialist'
            WHEN visa_types BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Hybrid Practitioner'
            ELSE 'Generalist' END AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS attorney_count,
       ROUND(AVG(asi), 2) AS avg_asi,
       ROUND(AVG(dom_pct), 2) AS avg_dominant_pct
FROM s
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY attorney_count DESC

WITH i AS (SELECT e.employer_contact_info->>'naics_code' AS naics_code, COUNT(*) AS total_applications FROM cases c JOIN employer e ON e.corphandle = c.homefirm AND e.zipref = c.homezip GROUP BY 1), p AS (SELECT naics_code, total_applications, ROUND(100.0 * total_applications / SUM(total_applications) OVER (), 2) AS percentage FROM i) SELECT naics_code, total_applications, percentage FROM p WHERE percentage > 15 ORDER BY percentage DESC
note: No workforce size in data; visa-dependent taken as industries with >15% of all applications.

answer: SELECT visacls AS visa_type, AVG(to_date(decisionday, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - to_date(recvday, 'YYYY/MM/DD')) AS avg_processing_days FROM cases WHERE UPPER(statustag) = 'CERTIFIED' AND NULLIF(decisionday, '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY visacls ORDER BY avg_processing_days DESC

WITH e AS (SELECT homefirm, homezip, COUNT(*) AS n, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') / COUNT(*) AS asr FROM cases GROUP BY homefirm, homezip) SELECT CASE WHEN n < 5 THEN 'Small-scale' WHEN n <= 25 THEN 'Medium-scale' ELSE 'Large-scale' END AS size_category, COUNT(*) AS employer_count, AVG(asr) AS avg_success_rate FROM e GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_success_rate DESC
